# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P39](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0039), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril possesses endearing good looks, magnificent dark eyes, and a slender frame. He sports a Wexcombe scarlet and white emblem attached to his coat lapel. When smiling, he exhibits what has been described as a deep, black, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## Personality

Cyril presents himself as a polite, constant, and somber young man with respectful manners and a romantic, poetical turn of mind. However, he lacks a sense of humor and fails to understand funny stories. Although he gives the impression of being a mysterious hero, others note that he ultimately lacks real substance or deeper interest.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Cyril was raised in Portmaris as part of the wealthy Gardner family. Two years prior to returning to Wexcombe, he abandoned his university studies to accompany his ill mother overseas after his father's death. Upon returning to university as a Junior, he aggressively courted Nell Harcourt with gifts of violets, poetry, and constant romantic attentions. Though his courtship was widely admired by spectators and college friends, his attentions toward Nell caused her subtle doubts due to his lack of humor. When he eventually expected to marry her, Nell rejected him in favor of her true feelings for Hugh Carrow, leaving Cyril pale and foolishly surprised by her refusal.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019), [v3 c40 P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016)_
